# Copilot Instructions For Bruinet

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before any Bruinet work and follow it. It is the one rule book for every agent:
what to read first, the skills, what never goes in a test, the core, synchronization, error-handling, package,
documentation and git rules, and the build and test commands. This file holds no rules of its own, so a rule
changes in one place.

Task workflows are the skills in [skills/](skills/), listed in `AGENTS.md`. Before one of those tasks, read its
`SKILL.md` and the reference it points to; if your tool does not load skills, open them directly. C# files also
follow [the comment policy](instructions/csharp-comments.instructions.md).
